title: Senior Manager - Payroll & HR
description:
Manager Payroll & HR Location: Kuntighat, Triveni, Kalyani
 Experience: 8-10 Years
 Salary: Up to 12 LPA
 Industry: Manufacturing | Highly Unionized Environment
 Employee Coverage: 2,000+ Job Summary We are looking for an experienced Senior Manager Payroll & HR to manage end-to-end payroll operations for 2,000+ employees in a highly unionized manufacturing environment. The role will oversee payroll, statutory compliance, LTS/union settlements, PMS-linked compensation, audits, HRMS/ERP, MIS, and team management. Key Responsibilities Manage end-to-end monthly payroll for 2,000+ employees with accuracy and timely salary disbursement. Handle complex payroll components including production incentives, LTS, allowances, overtime, bonus, VPF, LIC, cooperative deductions, and variable pay . Ensure compliance with PF, ESI, PT, TDS, Bonus, Gratuity and applicable labour laws . Manage EPFO, ESIC, TRACES, ECR, Form 24Q, Form 16 and other statutory requirements. Handle LTS, union wage settlements, payroll-related grievances, and employee relations . Ensure accurate processing of PMS-linked increments, promotions, bonuses, incentives, and performance payouts . Lead PF/statutory/internal audits , payroll reconciliations, and compliance reviews. Manage and optimize SAP/Oracle/HRMS payroll systems and drive payroll automation. Prepare payroll MIS, cost reports, variance analysis, dashboards, and management reports . Lead and develop a team of 2–3 payroll professionals . Drive process improvement, SOP implementation, automation, controls, and payroll risk management . Education MBA/PGDM – HR / HRM / Industrial Relations or equivalent. Certification in Payroll, Labour Laws, Taxation or Compensation & Benefits will be an advantage. Required Experience & Skills 8–10 years of experience in Payroll & HR Operations . Minimum 5 years’ experience handling payroll for 1,500+ employees , preferably in a unionized manufacturing setup. Strong knowledge of EPF, ESI, PT, TDS, Bonus Act, Gratuity Act, Labour Laws and Payroll Compliance . Strong exposure to LTS, union settlements, incentives and complex compensation structures . Advanced MS Excel – Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Dashboards, Macros/VBA . Hands-on experience with SAP/Oracle/HRMS and statutory portals . Strong analytical, reconciliation, stakeholder management and team leadership skills.

Key Skills: HR policies,Payroll management,Senior management,Hrsd,Performance,Payroll,Appraisal,Employee engagement
